readme: PL03 and PL10 are described as tested under a 0%-60% SOC condition at C/2 and room temperature (25 +/- 2 C).
The README describes the Operation field as identifying the operation type and cycle count and gives meanings and units for the eight exported measurements.
Current is positive for charge and negative for discharge; Charge and Discharge are cumulative Ah counters.
The README notes that 'Missing Data' operation records were not recorded because of a test-system software fault.

The README does not define 'Single Cycle' as a full-capacity characterization or reference-performance test, does not state a full-charge acceptance rule, and does not define how to select reference capacity.

single_cycle.label_interpretation: The label says Single Cycle; it does not document a full-capacity reference test.

partial_cycle.interpretation: These are explicitly partial-cycle operations, including the label '100 Partial Cycles'; the number 100 is not documentation of a 100% SOC reference test.

documented_but_unavailable_operations.readme_reason: Test-system software fault; operation data was not recorded.

observed_single_cycle_measurements.meaning: The following are values of the exported cumulative Discharge_Ah counter at the end of the candidate discharge interval. They are not approved reference capacities.
observed_single_cycle_measurements.candidate_interval: Step 6, negative current near -0.75 A; voltage reaches approximately 2.75 V.

not_established: That each Single Cycle export is a reference-performance/full-capacity characterization operation.

That the brief measured charge steps before Step 6 constitute complete conditioning or full charging. Positive current and voltage near 4.2 V are observed, but a complete CC-CV sequence and charge-termination criterion are not documented; the recorded preceding charge counters are small.
That approximately 2.75 V is the configured or protocol-defined discharge cutoff. It is an observed endpoint in Step 6, not a documented cutoff rule in the README.

That the final cumulative Discharge_Ah counter is an accepted capacity measurement for SOH. Counter reset semantics, test acceptance rules, calibration details, and a reference-capacity selection procedure are not documented in the reviewed material.
That either of the two Single Cycle measurements per cell can serve as a stable baseline. Their observed discharge counters differ, and the reason for that difference is not established.
missing_evidence: An authoritative CALCE protocol or Arbin schedule mapped to the four Single Cycle source-operation rows, specifying the intended operation purpose and whether it is reference-performance characterization.

Per-cell charge/conditioning records immediately preceding each proposed capacity test, including CC-CV setpoints, voltage limit, CV termination current or time, rest period, and evidence that charge completion criteria were met.
The documented discharge rate, lower voltage cutoff, termination behavior, and any rest or stabilization steps for the capacity test.
CALCE's definition of the capacity result for this protocol, including whether the cumulative Ah counter resets at the test boundary and which cycle/step interval is the accepted measured capacity.

A source-backed rule for choosing each cell's reference capacity (for example, a designated initial reference-performance test or protocol-defined baseline), rather than choosing a denominator from observed maxima.

recommendation.next_verifiable_source: Obtain from CALCE the original protocol/test schedule and experiment records for PL03 and PL10 corresponding to source operation rows 2 and 18, including the Arbin step definitions and complete preceding charge logs. Request explicit confirmation that these operations are reference-capacity tests and the prescribed capacity extraction/reference-selection rule.
recommendation.if_original_records_are_unavailable: Keep historical CALCE SOH labeling blocked. A new controlled reference-performance experiment on the same cells could establish prospective capacity measurements only if cell identity and protocol continuity are documented; it cannot retroactively prove that the historical Single Cycle exports were valid reference tests.
recommendation.decision_until_evidence_is_obtained: Do not assign these candidate counters as reference capacity, do not generate CALCE SOH labels, and do not train a CALCE SOH model.
